findings.claim: Loop goal: beat Sarvam Vision 2.1 87.39 avg accuracy on Sarvam Indic OCR Bench (6,909 blocks, 22 langs+EN) using comparable probe22 subset (18 langs, 100/lang); may not train on Sarvam bench nor use Sarvam beyond 54-call cap.
Primary outcome: W6 model/wrap routing per-lang CER >=3 pp lower than Sarvam's worst measured cells (KS, mni, sat, or, OldScan).

Loop IN/OUT scope: backbone GLM-OCR 0.9B primary; QLoRA kok+pa (Option A); metrics McNemar+Wilson+Ph6; OUT: new backbone invention (S9), training on barred langs (S6.4), Sarvam beyond 54 cap (D2), cloud GPU without budget (D1), swap to Qwen3.5-9B without QLoRA eval.
Done state requires: per-lang winner only when n>=50 and McNemar p<0.05 vs >=5/10 opponents; >=3 SAFE langs with |dCER|>=3pt vs Sarvam; K1 McNemar p<0.05 vs Sarvam_on_3_per_lang.

Eval discipline in loop: paperthin/mandela eval-leakage audit at Gate C; factchk at every measurement; hate objection at gate A; Wilson CI upper < next engine point; McNemar paired exact; Reviewer/Judge split.

Loop termination guards: max_iterations 12, revise cap 3/gate, no-progress stop after 2 iterations (CER delta <0.005 or McNemar drift >0.10), wall clock 8h/iteration, budget $0 (D1 LOCKED no cloud), cross-vendor egress NONE.

Gate C kill: K4 memory peak >12 GB kills QLoRA -> wrap-only; no metric improvement in 2 iterations kills QLoRA. Gate A options: A=wrap+QLoRA, B=wrap-only, C=new backbone (escalate redesign). Loop timeline W6 Oct 2-8, W7 eval Oct 9-10.

Loop explicitly encodes 6/18 langs BARRED from training per S6.4 GT verdicts; Sarvam comparison benchmark differs from probe (different benchmark). Sat/ks/mni GT integrity needs 10-min human spot-check.
Loop host is opencode MiniMax-M3; hardware assumption macOS/MLX; mlx-tune install failure -> ship wrap-only; Sarvam bench download needs user approval (S9).

GLM-OCR (0.9B, OmniDocBench #1, official MLX deploy) chosen as D1 W6 recipe primary candidate, replacing Qwen2.5-VL-3B in R7 W6 training tree; mlx-tune (1.4k stars, MLX-native SFT/DPO/GRPO, ships CER/WER, Apache-2.0) is QLoRA tool.
dots.mocr (3B, MIT, multilingual Elo 1124.7, Old-scans 48.2) = head-to-head vs GLM-OCR for OldScan 55.3 weak cell.
MonkeyOCRv2 (0.7B Apache-2.0 code+weights, MDPBench 83.3, Hindi 71.9) flagged smallest strong fine-tune backbone; evaluate on Indic subset.

Other keep-as-reference OCR: liteparse (12.7k stars Rust PDF front end, M2 Max measured), HunyuanOCR-1.5 (ancient-script data flow, license review), Unlimited-OCR (26.4k stars long-horizon for OldScan), light-ocr CoreML PP-OCRv6, anydoc, datalab lift 9B JSON.
HunyuanOCR (Tencent Hunyuan Community License, not pure OSS) is a license risk flag; REVIEW before any use. Do NOT migrate harness mid-campaign.
DeepSeek-OCR-2 MLX is a CONTRADICTION: repo claims runnable, mlx-tune README says not loadable; do not block W6 on it.

Honest-empty: no new dedicated Ol Chiki / Nastaliq / Meitei-Mayek OCR repos in 6-month scan; sat/ks/OldScan/or remain vision-LLM-only or W6 fine-tune targets; no OldScan restoration repos; no new Indic doc layout beyond IndicPhotoOCR.

Tooling: paperthin (28 skills; mandela/factchk/hate/sip/catchup/nba) and looper installed; npx global install failed (PromptScript), manual git clone + cp to ~/.config/opencode/skills; graph 3990 nodes/4681 edges/420 communities over 18,239 files; ECC 215 skills.
